name: RadioGroup
description: Single-select group with controlled and controller-driven modes, row and card item shapes, roving arrow-key traversal and form participation.

fields.direction: Axis? - arrow-key reading order; null = the widget's own
fields.items: SelectableRadioTheme? - row styling (gap, itemPadding, labelStyle, indicator rows)
fields.card: SelectableCardTheme? - card surface styling (padding, borderRadius, per-state fill and border, gap)

notes: `RadioItem` (the row) and `RadioIndicator` live in `primitives/selectable_radio/`: `select`, `menu` and `tabs` need the same rows, and the item is only here a consumer of the group's selection scope.
`RadioCard` and `SelectableCardTheme` stay with the component: a card is a component-layer surface, so the layer 2 primitive may not import `Card`.
`ControlledRadioGroup` and the `ControlledComponent` adapter are deleted; one widget with two modes, like `Switch`.

The old `RadioCard`/`Radio` classes are gone as such: `RadioCard` is a card item and `RadioIndicator` is the circle, both themed through the group's own rows so an indicator leg can no longer disagree with the item that drew it.

The arrow-key traversal is registered on each item's `Clickable` (`shortcuts`/`actions`), not on a `Shortcuts` above the items: `Clickable` binds the arrow keys to directional focus and the nearest `Shortcuts` wins.

`NextItemIntent`/`PreviousItemIntent` are now the primitive's `NextRovingItemIntent`/`PreviousRovingItemIntent`; the old names were ambiguous and the old handlers all selected the focused item instead of moving.
